subject: Wrong item received — Order ORD-1001
body:
Hi Support,

I ordered a Wireless Keyboard (Order ORD-1001, $89.99) but received a completely different item — a USB Hub. I have attached my original receipt for reference.

This is quite frustrating as I needed the keyboard for work. Could you please arrange a replacement or issue a full refund?

Thank you,
Sarah Mitchell

subject: Damaged product on arrival — ORD-1003
body:
Hello,

My Laptop Stand (Order ORD-1003, $59.99) arrived with a cracked base — it's completely unusable. I've attached the invoice for your records. I am requesting a full refund as I no longer trust the quality of this item.

Please process this urgently.

Regards,
James Okafor

subject: Invoice amount is wrong — ORD-1012
body:
Hi,

I received invoice #ORD-1012 for a 4K Monitor but the amount charged ($749.99) does not match the agreed price of $649.99 at the time of purchase.

I have attached the incorrect invoice. Please reissue a corrected invoice and process a refund for the difference of $100.00.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma

subject: App keeps crashing on startup — not order related
body:
Hi Team,

I downloaded your desktop companion app last week and it crashes every single time I open it. I'm on Windows 11 (22H2). I've tried reinstalling three times. No error message, it just closes immediately.

This is very frustrating. Can someone from technical support look into this?

David Chen

subject: Order still not delivered — ORD-1007
body:
Hello,

My order ORD-1007 (Mechanical Keyboard, $149.99) was placed 8 days ago and was supposed to arrive within 5 business days. Tracking shows it's been stuck in transit for 4 days.

Can you please investigate and either deliver the item or issue a refund? I've attached my receipt.

Thanks,
Emily Watson

subject: Refund request for returned item — ORD-1005
body:
Hi,

I returned my Mouse (ORD-1005, $49.99) via courier 10 days ago as it had a faulty scroll wheel from day one. The tracking shows the return was delivered to your warehouse 7 days ago.

I have not received my refund yet. Can you please process it? The receipt is attached.

Carlos Rivera

subject: Double charged for Order ORD-1009
body:
Hello Support,

I was charged twice for Order ORD-1009 (USB-C Hub, $45.99). I can see two identical charges of $45.99 on my credit card statement from the same date.

Please refund the duplicate charge immediately. I can provide bank statement screenshots if needed.

Ananya Patel

subject: Wrong colour item — want replacement ORD-1016
body:
Hi,

I ordered a Black Desk Lamp (ORD-1016, $45.99) but received a white one. I'd prefer a replacement in the correct colour rather than a refund. Please arrange this.

I've attached the receipt.

Michael Brown

subject: Missing item from order ORD-1019
body:
Hello,

I received my Docking Station (ORD-1019, $189.99) but the box was missing the power adapter that is listed in the product description as included.

Is this a packing error? Can you send the missing adapter or issue a partial refund?

Sophie Turner

subject: Invoice request for Order ORD-1020
body:
Hi,

I need a proper tax invoice for Order ORD-1020 (External SSD, $119.99) for my business expense claim. The receipt I received does not show the GST breakdown.

Could you please reissue the invoice with a full tax breakdown?

Thanks,
Kevin Nguyen

subject: Product not as described — ORD-1011
body:
Hello,

The Drawing Tablet I received (ORD-1011, $299.99) is an older model (2022) but I ordered the 2024 edition as listed on your website. I have screenshots of the product listing.

This is misleading advertising. I want either the correct 2024 model sent as a replacement or a full refund.

Laura Jenkins

subject: Password reset not working — account locked
body:
Hi,

I've been trying to reset my account password for 2 days but I'm not receiving the reset email. My account seems to be locked. I've checked spam folders.

Can someone manually reset my account or help me get back in? My registered email is omar.h@example.com.

Omar Hassan

subject: Refund for cancelled order ORD-9999
body:
Hi Support,

I cancelled order ORD-9999 immediately after placing it (within 2 minutes) but was still charged $234.50. The cancellation confirmation says the order was cancelled but the charge went through anyway.

Please refund this as I do not have an invoice for a cancelled order.

Nina Clarke

subject: General enquiry about warranty on ORD-1004
body:
Hello,

I purchased a Monitor (ORD-1004, $449.99) 6 months ago. I'd like to know what the warranty covers and how to make a warranty claim if the backlight starts failing.

Do I need to send the unit in? What is the turnaround time?

Thank you,
Raj Patel

subject: Ergonomic Chair arrived scratched — ORD-1015
body:
Hi,

My Ergonomic Chair (ORD-1015, $499.99) was delivered yesterday. When I unpacked it I found multiple scratches on the armrests and a small crack on the base. I've attached photos — my receipt is also attached.

Given the price of this item, I expect either a replacement unit or a significant partial refund. Please advise.

Zoe Campbell

subject: Subscription billed after cancellation
body:
Hi,

I cancelled my monthly subscription on Aug 28th but was billed again on September 1st for $19.99. I have the cancellation confirmation email.

Please refund the September charge and confirm the subscription is cancelled.

Tom Harrison

subject: How do I track my order ORD-1018?
body:
Hello,

I placed an order for a Power Strip (ORD-1018, $34.99) 3 days ago. I haven't received any tracking information yet. Could you send me the tracking number?

Thank you,
Fatima Al-Rashid

subject: Keyboard tray instructions missing — ORD-1017
body:
Hi,

I received the Keyboard Tray (ORD-1017, $79.99) but there were no assembly instructions in the box. The product requires assembly and I'm not sure how to proceed. Could you email me a PDF of the instructions or a link to a guide?

Liam Murphy
